Name: Star Crossed - A Rival Hearts and Marriage Mod
Author: kcspace
Description:
[left][img]https://i.imgur.com/dR7ODdX.png[/img][/left]
[left][size=4][b]Star Crossed pairs up 6 couples with their own unique love stories.[/b]


Each couple has at least 3 rival heart events, an engagement event, a wedding, and a post-marriage event. Couples who get married
will move in together and redecorate their homes. Spouses will also meet up together during their new schedules and during festivals.


If playing family variants, couples will ask for your help upgrading their homes so they can have children who grow up to become interactable NPCs. There are 6 total children that can be added.


If playing childfree variants, couples will ask for your help upgrading their homes so they can have more space for their hobbies.


Sebastian and Abigail have an infertility variant (that is on by default) which contains an event discussing their infertility. Selecting the
childfree variant in the config menu changes this event to them discussing their decision to be childfree by choice.


Harvey and Maru only have a childfree by choice variant.[/size]

[color=#ff0000][size=5][b]Please Note: Villagers will no longer be romanceable after their respective engagement scenes.[/b][/size][/color]

[size=4]This mod is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9695]Little Red School House [/url]﻿(both versions), [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6966]Community Center Reimagined[/url]﻿, and [/size][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44103]Spouses Move House[/url][/size][size=4].

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28284]Cross-Mod Compatibility Tokens (CMCT)[/url]﻿ for compatibility with Community Center Reimagined and Little Red Schoolhouse (only if you're using the five day school week).

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8a4UlOI.png[/img]﻿

[b][color=#e69138]Original Versions:[/color]
[/b]Includes all rival heart events, engagement events, weddings, and a post-marriage event. Includes minor map and schedule changes to reflect couples moving in together.

[b][color=#e69138]Family Versions:[/color][/b]
﻿Includes all rival heart events, engagement events, weddings, and post-marriage events. Includes major map and schedule changes to reflect couples moving in together. Also includes events involving couples becoming parents, the player meeting the new children, and adds new NPCs with their own events.


[b][color=#e69138]Childfree Versions: [/color][/b]
﻿Includes all rival heart events, engagement events, weddings, and post-marriage events. Includes major map and schedule
changes to reflect couples moving in together.  Does not add any new NPCs.


[color=#e69138][b]Infertility Version (Sebastian and Abigail only):[/b]  [/color]
﻿Includes all rival heart events, engagement events, weddings, and post-marriage events. Includes major map and schedule changes to reflect the couple moving in together.  Does not add any new NPCs, and includes an event where they discuss their infertility.


[b][color=#e69138]Turned Off:[/color][/b]
Selecting “Turned Off” prevents all rival heart events, map, and schedule changes from taking effect for that couple.


[b][color=#e69138]Time Between Events: [/color][/b]
Adjusts the length of time required to pass between events until marriage. Set to 3 days by default. House upgrades and post-marriage dates have preset event cooldowns for 7 days, and 14 days, respectively.


[b][color=#e69138]Turn Off Event Cooldowns:[/color][/b]
﻿Checking this box in the config menu turns off cooldowns between rival events, post marriage events, and house
upgrades. [b][color=#cc0000]DOES NOT[/color][/b] change the event cooldowns for adding children. These cooldowns [b][color=#cc0000]CANNOT[/color][/b] be skipped by changing the date. The game counts them by nights slept.


[b][color=#e69138]Compatibility Mode: [/color][/b]
﻿Prevents engaged rival NPCs from being able to be befriended to 10 hearts. They will continue to show as 'Single' in the relationship
tab. Helpful if you have dialogue expansion mods installed that add flirty dialogue to NPCs after 8 hearts.


[b][color=#e69138]Fall House Upgrades Requirement: [/color][/b]
﻿Unchecking this box in the config menu removes the requirement to have seen the event adding the special order board cutscene before the couples’ homes can be upgraded. If you uncheck this box and complete the upgrades before the special order board cutscene you will have a floating ticket available in town that cannot be collected until after seeing the event with Lewis and Robin.[/size]
